fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Detached Structure; Open Lawn Area; Storage Area; Walkway; Equipment Storage Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Multiple Structures; Limited Rear Access; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of approach.
• Post the property address at the driveway entry so responders can confirm the correct location without leaving the road.
• Mark the entrance to the detached structures clearly so responders can locate them quickly without searching the property.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structures clear of stored equipment and materials.
• Keep the storage area and equipment storage area clear of items that could block responder movement around the structures.
• Maintain a clear path from the vehicle parking area to both structures to allow responders to move equipment without obstruction.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear enough for emergency vehicles to turn around, given the single access point.
• Trim any vegetation along the single access point that narrows the driveway or reduces visibility for approaching vehicles.
• If the rear of the property is accessible only through the open lawn area, mark a clear route so responders can navigate to the rear without delay.
• Keep any gates between the front and rear of the property unlocked or secured with a mechanism responders can open quickly.
